paragraphs: Meremar: Huna Mar bar Meremar; Yehudah Mar bar Meremar. Dorot Olam writes that Meremar was head after Rav Ashi. Yuḥasin [seventh generation of amoraim] says this is unconvincing: the end of Mo'ed Katan says, 'They press the feet of Rav Huna bar Natan'; he appears to have been head after Rav Ashi (see his entry). See part 1, year 4187, and what I wrote there.
